newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 6.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 6.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Ten members of parliament have not submitted their declaration of property, although the deadline was Monday evening.
- Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy reassured the general secretary of the Teachers' Trade Union that the ministry did not plan to reduce subsidies to education next year.
- IFABO, an international computer technology fair has opened in Budapest.
- The Foreign Ministry has begun preparations for for the planned visit of President Arpad Goncz to Romania at the end of May, the ministry said.

- The quality of the water of Lake Velencei, a popular touristic spot, is endangered by delayed developments in the sewage network of the area around the lake, participants of an environmental protection conference said.
